title: Repair removes the antecedent but leaves the sentence that points to it

provenance.note: Quoted in the newlyOrphaned source comment from a live repaired chapter. Names redacted to synthetic tokens.

manuscript.quote: Zor's back arched against the parapet. It was not Pax's wrist.

diagnosis: The surviving sentence is grammatical but its pronoun and contrast refer to a sentence the repair deleted.

test.before: Zor's back arched against the parapet. His fingers closed on metal and crushed it. It was not Pax's wrist. He let go.
test.after: Zor's back arched against the parapet. It was not Pax's wrist. He let go.
